novel_features.name: Recovery-vs-strain efficiency curve
novel_features.description: Buckets cycles by strain (0-5, 5-10, 10-15, 15-21) and shows mean recovery per bucket vs. the prior equivalent window.

novel_features.name: Sleep debt cumulative tracker
novel_features.description: Cumulative sum of need_from_sleep_debt_milli weekly, with trend slope and human-friendly interpretation.

novel_features.name: Overtraining detector
novel_features.description: Flags days where strain exceeds N sigma above the 90-day mean and shows the recovery delta vs. window mean.

novel_features.name: Pairwise metric correlation
novel_features.description: Pearson correlation between any two whitelisted WHOOP metrics over a chosen window.

novel_features.name: Why-was-today-bad attribution
novel_features.description: Ranks today's recovery, HRV, RHR, sleep consistency, and prior-day strain by abs(z-score) vs. personal 14-day baseline.

novel_features.name: Raw SQL escape hatch
novel_features.description: Execute read-only SELECT/WITH queries (or read-only PRAGMAs like table_info, table_list, foreign_key_list for schema introspection) against the local SQLite store. Accept the query as a positional arg or via --query.

novel_features.name: FTS5 cross-resource search
novel_features.description: FTS5 full-text search across all synced resources (cycle, sleep, recovery, workouts).
